Dal Fry Recipe
this recipe serves around 4-5 people so can easily be halved for your 2 person household! 

Ingredients + Method ( all together so you can cook 

Pressure Cook Dal first
-120 grams Masoor Dal, washed then soaked for 30 minutes followed by a 3-4 whistle pressure cook
-Pressure cook with 1/2 tsp haldi (turmeric powder) + 1 tsp ghee + pinch of hing
-use the finger meethod to determine the amount of water - the water level should be as much as the first cut on your finger when dipped in 
-pressure cook for 3 whistles and allow the cooker to release

For the Masala:
add 1 tbsp ghee/oil for a vegan option to your saucepan 
add to that 1 large onions, finely chopped along with 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste eachand 3 green chillies ( 1 finely chopped + 2 sliced in half) along with 1 stick of curry leaves, plucked  till soft and the onion goes translucent 
follow that up with pinch of hing +1 tsp turmeric powder (haldi) + 1 tsp red chilli powder + 1 tsp coriander powder ( im obsessed with this ingredient and will never not use it) and cook for 5 minutes to allow the masala to bhuno ( basically cook slightly in your onion mix) if you feel your masala sticking to the pot at this point, put in either 2 ice cubes or some water ( eye ball it just enough to get it not stick) 
then add in 2 large tomatoes, finely chopped - this will complete “deglaze” the pan of the masalas and it will come together. at this point, ideally you dont need to add water but if you actually feel like it is sticking a few tbsp will work. allow it to cook for 10 minutes till the tomatoes are super soft and add in salt, to taste
add in your cooked dal along with 1/2 or 1 cup of water depending on how thick or thin you want your dal ( i go with 1/2 cup because thick dal FTW always) 
follow that up with 1.5 tsp garam masala and cook for 5-10 minutes. once done, add in 1 tbsp kasturi methi  and switch off the heat. 
juice of one lemon, just before you eat the dal 
bunch of coriander leaves, chopped
